summary: End-to-end testing of Lead Magnet feature (workspace config, file upload, manual send, public tracking, engagement) plus TTV milestone watcher + Sonner Toaster, plus regression on existing endpoints. 14/14 backend tests passed; all UI flows verified including config save round-trip, toggle color flip, file dropzone, send brochure with happy/error toasts, engagement card with hot badge, dashboard ttv-tracker, onboarding step 4 preview.

minor.issue: tracking_url returned is a relative path (e.g. '/api/lead-magnets/track/<id>') because backend reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/BACKEND_URL env which are NOT set in /app/backend/.env. _build_tracking_url falls back to empty string. The URL embedded in actual outbound emails/whatsapp messages would be unclickable for recipients. Recommend either (a) setting BACKEND_URL in backend/.env to the public preview URL, or (b) using request.url_for / Host header to construct an absolute URL.

action_items: Backend: tracking_url returned by /api/leads/{id}/send-lead-magnet is RELATIVE because backend reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env (not set in backend/.env). Add BACKEND_URL to backend/.env or build absolute URL from request Host header — otherwise email/whatsapp recipients cannot click the embedded tracking link.
Optional: server.py is 3416 lines (was 3105) — splitting into modules (lead_magnet.py, ttv.py, leads.py, etc.) is overdue.
critical_code_review_comments: auto_send_lead_magnet idempotency check correctly queries lead_magnet_views with kind='send' + trigger=trigger to prevent duplicate auto-sends per trigger. Good.
send_lead_magnet_manual: trigger='manual' is NOT idempotent by design (founder can manually re-send). This is correct but worth documenting.
/api/uploads/{file_id} path-traversal guard via os.path.commonpath is good. However it relies on the file_id ending with the saved extension; uploaded file_id is uuid+ext, so this is safe.
_build_tracking_url silently returns '/api/...' when env missing — should warn or raise at startup if BACKEND_URL is required for production. Currently tracking links break silently.

LeadMagnetConfig pydantic model: type='url'|'file' is not enum-validated; invalid values would persist. Consider Literal['url','file'] and Literal['pre_booking','post_booking','both'] for stricter validation.
WhatsApp send is logged-only (no real API integration) — confirmed expected per problem statement, but ensure this is documented in product copy so founders don't expect actual delivery.
seed_data_creation: Created/updated workspace lead_magnet config (TEST_UI_Brochure / TEST_Brochure prefixed). Created multiple test send + view records on existing lead 69e081b5cd724a3d376691c4. Uploaded one TEST PDF to /app/backend/uploads.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Lead Magnet features work end-to-end. The single notable issue is that backend's _build_tracking_url returns a relative URL because REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is not in backend/.env. The endpoint itself works (302 redirect verified), but emails sent in production would contain broken links. Existing lead 69e081b5cd724a3d376691c4 now has 5+ sends and 3+ views (is_hot=true). Workspace magnet is currently configured as enabled=true, type=url, url=https://example.com/test_ui_brochure.pdf, send_timing=post_booking.
rca of the issue: Relative tracking URL: /app/backend/server.py line ~3147 uses os.getenv('REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL') or os.getenv('BACKEND_URL', ''). Backend .env contains only MONGO_URL — neither var is set. Result: base=''.rstrip('/') → '' so tracking_url becomes '/api/lead-magnets/track/<id>'. Mitigation: add BACKEND_URL=https://pipeline-pro-96.preview.emergentagent.com to /app/backend/.env (or fallback to constructing from FastAPI Request object's base_url).
